title: dotenv
standardAlternative: Node's built-in process.loadEnvFile() and util.parseEnv() (Node 20.12+/21.7+) cover reading a .env file into process.env.

excluded.reason: Tests the dotenv command-line program (dist/cli.cjs) by spawning it; the CLI is not part of the library API.
Tests signal forwarding of the dotenv command-line program by spawning it.

Spawns Node processes that import the published package entry points ('dotenv', 'dotenv/config', './config.js', -r preload) by package name; the grader's module redirection does not reach child processes, and package entry points and ESM interop are packaging, not library behaviour.

Unit-tests the private lib/config-options module (optionsFromEnv) and spawns the built package and CLI in child processes. The environment-default behaviour it covers is tested in-process by test-config.js and the config fuzz target.

Spawns child Node processes that load dist/index.cjs and the dist/config.cjs preload by absolute path, outside the grader's module redirection. The quiet-from-.env behaviour it covers is exercised by the config fuzz target, which records console output.

notes: Upstream runs these files with node-tap 21 (tap run); each file also runs directly with node and prints TAP, which is how the grader runs them (runner node, tap 21.7.4 and sinon 14.0.1 as pinned in upstream's package-lock.json). test-config.js and test-populate.js stub fs.readFileSync, os.homedir, path.relative and console with sinon on the CommonJS built-in objects; shims/sinon.cjs wraps sinon so every stub and restore also calls module.syncBuiltinESMExports(), which makes the stubs visible to an ESM module whatever import form it uses for node:fs, node:os and node:path (verified with a port that uses named imports). shims/main.cjs gives the tests a plain, stubbable object holding the module's four functions.
